name: Answer Callback Query
Parse Telegram Command
Handle Boot Command
Handle Shutdown Command
Handle Force Shutdown
Handle Status Command
Handle Help Command
Handle Commands List
func:
// Comprehensive command listing across all automation domains
const commandsText = `📋 *Complete Command Reference*

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `🖥️ *SERVER MANAGEMENT*

` +
    `*Boot Commands:*
` +
    `🟢 \`/boot dell\` - Boot Dell T310 (WoL)
` +
    `🟢 \`/boot hp\` - Boot HP DL360p (iLO)

` +
    `*Shutdown Commands:*
` +
    `🟠 \`/shutdown dell\` - Graceful shutdown Dell T310
` +
    `🟠 \`/shutdown hp\` - Graceful shutdown HP DL360p
` +
    `   _(Timeout: 300s)_

` +
    `*Force Commands:*
` +
    `🔴 \`/force dell\` - Force shutdown Dell T310
` +
    `🔴 \`/force hp\` - Force shutdown HP DL360p
` +
    `   ⚠️ _Immediate power off_

` +
    `*Status Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/status\` - Get all server status
` +
    `   _Shows: Dell T310, HP DL360p_

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `🚪 *MAIN GATE AUTOMATION*

` +
    `*Control Commands:*
` +
    `🚪 \`/gate_open\` or \`/gate\` - Open main gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 2 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `*Status Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/gate_status\` - Get main gate status
` +
    `   _Shows: Power, Relays 1-4, Mains, Keypad_

` +
    `*Help Commands:*
` +
    `❓ \`/gate_help\` - Show main gate help

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `🚪 *SLIDING GATE AUTOMATION*

` +
    `*Control Commands:*
` +
    `🔓 \`/sliding_open\` - Open sliding gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 1 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `🔒 \`/sliding_close\` - Close sliding gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 2 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `🔄 \`/sliding_trigger\` - Trigger automation
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 3 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `*Status Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/sliding_status\` - Get sliding gate status
` +
    `   _Shows: Relays 1-4 status_

` +
    `*Help Commands:*
` +
    `❓ \`/sliding_help\` - Show sliding gate help

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `🚪 *SECONDARY GATE AUTOMATION*

` +
    `*Gate Control Commands:*
` +
    `🔓 \`/secondary_open\` - Open secondary gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 2 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `🔒 \`/secondary_close\` - Close secondary gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 1 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `🔄 \`/secondary_trigger\` - Trigger automation
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 3 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `🛑 \`/secondary_stop\` - Stop gate
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 4 (1 sec pulse)_

` +
    `*Light Control Commands:*
` +
    `💡 \`/secondary_light_left\` - Left light
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 5 (120 sec timer)_

` +
    `💡 \`/secondary_light_right\` - Right light
` +
    `   _Activates Relay 6 (120 sec timer)_

` +
    `*Status Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/secondary_status\` - Get gate & light status
` +
    `   _Shows: All 6 relays status_

` +
    `*Help Commands:*
` +
    `❓ \`/secondary_help\` - Show secondary gate help

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `⚡ *GARDEN POWER MONITORING*

` +
    `*Control Commands:*
` +
    `🟢 \`/garden_on\` - Turn ON garden power
` +
    `   _Activates Sonoff Power device_

` +
    `⚫ \`/garden_off\` - Turn OFF garden power
` +
    `   _Deactivates Sonoff Power device_

` +
    `🔄 \`/garden_toggle\` - Toggle power state
` +
    `   _Switches between ON/OFF_

` +
    `*Monitoring Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/garden_status\` - Get power status
` +
    `   _Shows: Power state, Voltage, Current, Power, Consumption_

` +
    `*Help Commands:*
` +
    `❓ \`/garden_help\` - Show garden power help

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `💡 *GARDEN LIGHTS CONTROL*

` +
    `*Control Commands:*
` +
    `🟢 \`/lights_on\` - Turn all 16 lights ON
` +
    `   _Controls all GardenAutomationLights + frontHousePower_

` +
    `⚫ \`/lights_off\` - Turn all 16 lights OFF
` +
    `   _Turns off all garden lights_

` +
    `*Status Commands:*
` +
    `📊 \`/lights_status\` - Get all lights status
` +
    `   _Shows: Status of all 16 lights (GardenAutomationLights 1-12, frontHousePower 13-16)_

` +
    `*Help Commands:*
` +
    `❓ \`/lights_help\` - Show garden lights help
` +
    `   _Detailed info about lights control system_

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `ℹ️ *GENERAL COMMANDS*

` +
    `❓ \`/help\` - Quick help with buttons
` +
    `📋 \`/commands\` or \`/list\` - This complete list
` +
    `🚀 \`/start\` - Start bot (shows help)

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `🔔 *AUTOMATIC NOTIFICATIONS*

` +
    `• Server state changes (online/offline)
` +
    `• Gate power status changes
` +
    `• Command execution responses

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `💡 *QUICK TIPS*

` +
    `• Default server is \`dell\` if not specified
` +
    `• Use buttons for faster access
` +
    `• All commands are case-insensitive
` +
    `• Check /status before operations

` +
    `━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

` +
    `*System Capabilities:*
` +
    `✅ Remote server boot/shutdown
` +
    `✅ Gate automation control (3 gates)
` +
    `✅ Power monitoring & control
` +
    `✅ Garden lights control (16 lights)
` +
    `✅ Real-time status monitoring
` +
    `✅ SMS & Telegram notifications
` +
    `✅ Command history & logging

` +
    `_Type /help for interactive buttons_`;

// Create inline keyboard with domain shortcuts
const inlineKeyboard = {
    inline_keyboard: [
        [
            { text: '🖥️ Server Status', callback_data: '/status' },
            { text: '🚪 Main Gate Status', callback_data: '/gate_status' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '🔓 Open Primary', callback_data: '/sliding_open' },
            { text: '🔒 Close Primary', callback_data: '/sliding_close' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '🔓 Open Secondary', callback_data: '/secondary_open' },
            { text: '🛑 Stop Secondary', callback_data: '/secondary_stop' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '🟢 Boot Dell', callback_data: '/boot dell' },
            { text: '🚪 Open Main Gate', callback_data: '/gate_open' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '🟢 Garden ON', callback_data: '/garden_on' },
            { text: '⚫ Garden OFF', callback_data: '/garden_off' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '🟢 All Lights ON', callback_data: '/lights_on' },
            { text: '⚫ All Lights OFF', callback_data: '/lights_off' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '📊 Lights Status', callback_data: '/lights_status' }
        ],
        [
            { text: '❓ Quick Help', callback_data: '/help' },
            { text: '🔄 Refresh List', callback_data: '/commands' }
        ]
    ]
};

msg.payload = {
    chatId: msg.telegram.chatId,
    type: 'message',
    content: commandsText,
    parse_mode: 'Markdown',
    options: {
        reply_markup: JSON.stringify(inlineKeyboard)
    }
};
msg.topic = 'send';

return msg;

Store HP Status
Format Response for Telegram
